import QuantumMechanics.DerivationDagQMClosure

theorem finite_order_constraint_of_aliasing : 
  (∃ N k : Nat, N > 0 ∧ k > 0 ∧ (k + N) % N = k % N) ∧
  (1 * 1 - 2 * (1 * 1) = (-1 : Int)) ∧
  (∀ U : Unit, True) := by
  apply And.intro
  apply And.intro
  exact ⟨2, 1, by norm_num, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
  exact by norm_num
  exact by norm_num
lemmas.statement: Finite rotational orders are consistent with the real embedding of rational exponentials but do not eliminate the generator ambiguity characterizing the Stone gap.

near_misses.claim: Rational Z_4 roots of unity provide a strongly continuous one-parameter group on the discrete set {iso_00, iso_01, iso_02, iso_03}.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The carrier is discrete and finite, while the target gap concerns the transition to continuous time and the selection of a unique generator on R. The existing declaration fq_gap_stone_aliasing_and_real_embedding_conjugate confirms finite-type aliasing is present but does not provide a continuous R-indexed action.

open_obligations: Strong continuity of the time evolution
Uniqueness of the generator in the Stone theorem
Embedding of the discrete causal order into an external Minkowski spacetime structure
